capabilities: Update all references to a block ID from the selected line
Bulk-fix invalid outgoing and incoming block references in the current note
Preview proposed changes in a confirmation modal before applying
Find and update references in both markdown notes and canvas files
disambiguation: Not a link checker or note splitter; it only rewrites existing block references after content has moved, it does not split notes itself.
extras: Operations are irreversible; the README warns users to review the confirmation dialog and back up the vault before bulk updates. Full documentation is hosted on an external site.
intentEvidence: Obsidian provides ways to extract text into a new note, either through its native features or various community plugins. However, there's a catch
motivation: The author keeps long notes in a PTKM system and regularly promotes sections into their own notes, which invalidates block links, so they built this tool to update them.
problem: When a section with a block ID is extracted into a new note, references in other notes keep pointing at the original file and become broken with no automatic fix.

relations.evidence: just like renaming tags in Obsidian (e.g., with Tag Wrangler), once links are updated, there is no automatic way to revert

summary: Block-reference repair tool that updates broken links across markdown and canvas files after you split or reorganize notes.
